chitchat: Boots at the back, smallest to largest, don't rearrange them.
I'll take scrap, wire, glass, and anything that isn't leaking.
No credit. There's a list. You aren't on the list.
If you want the good jerky you have to ask for the good jerky.
description: A small sharp woman behind a counter made from the bed of a truck, doing three things at once and losing at none of them. She has the particular expression of a shopkeeper working out what you can afford before you have finished saying hello, and no apparent intention of holding it against you.

bye.text: "Jar goes back on the counter when you're done with it."

options.label: Let me see what you have.

list.text:
"Eleven names." She doesn't look at it. "It isn't a debt list, it's the opposite of a debt list. It's who doesn't have to ask.

Kesh is on it because she's up to her arms in the tanks at four in the morning and doesn't think to eat. Vane is on it because his hands are gone. Ossa is on it because he's fifteen and eats like a fire."

A shrug. "It comes back. It always comes back. Usually as something I didn't want, in a quantity I can't store."

options.label: Let me see what you have.

outsiders.text:
"When they come. They mostly do not." A dry look. "They get as far as the poles and they have a good long think and they go home, which is the poles working exactly as intended, so I can hardly complain about it and I do, constantly.

You got past them. So either you're stupid or you're broke. Both is common."

root.first: "You'll be wanting water, and you aren't having the tank water, you're having a jar of it like everybody else." She's already reaching for one. "Rindle. This is mine. What else."

options.label: Let me see what you have.

text_by_relation.close: "Sit on the crate, you look wrecked." The jar arrives without being ordered or charged for.
text_by_relation.familiar: "There's a pair of boots come in your size. I put them by. Don't make me regret it."

shop.text: "Go on then. Don't handle the glass."

which.text: "I think you're still standing there talking to me instead of looking at the boots, so you aren't shopping, you're gawping." She isn't unkind about it. "Gawp cheaper. There's a bench."

clothing_layers: a canvas apron with eleven pockets
a faded shirt buttoned to the throat

name: Rindle Ashcroft
